## Activity

West Gate Eye Clinic completed 269 captures during March 2021. This records the volume of imaging activity undertaken at the site during the month. The available activity information indicates that the clinic maintained its imaging service throughout the reporting period.

## Image quality

Of the captures completed, 10 were ungradable. The ungradable rate was 3.7%. These results identify the images that could not be assessed for grading and provide a measure of overall image quality for the month. Staff raised no new equipment faults during the reporting period.

## Grading

There were 58 referable results. The median lag for grading was 1. This measure records the typical interval associated with grading activity and should be considered alongside the number of referable results and the image quality findings. Overall, the report provides a summary of site activity, image usability and grading outcomes for March 2021.
